what: Search hook enforcement fix: pre-search-nudge.sh must NOT write to searched-queries tracking file on block. Tracking is only written by track-search.sh (PostToolUse:aide_search) after aide_search is actually called. This matches the read hook pattern (pre-read-recall.sh doesn't track, track-recall.sh does). Without this, agent can bypass search blocking by retrying the same grep.
why: Bug found in this session: search hook tracked on block, so retrying grep bypassed the hook. Same class of bug as if pre-read-recall.sh wrote to recalled-paths — the block becomes meaningless.
